title: CredentialCommand
responsibility: Registers harness credential: serve, request, status, attach, finish and recipe digest or verify.

inputs.name: CredentialCommand.register.program
inputs.description: Root Commander program.

inputs.name: CredentialRecipeCommand.register.credential
inputs.description: The credential command group.

inputs.name: CredentialRecipeCommand.options.command
inputs.description: Command that takes --review and --reviewers.

inputs.name: CredentialRecipeCommand.files.recipe
inputs.description: Recipe file path.

inputs.name: CredentialRecipeCommand.files.options
inputs.description: Parsed options holding review and reviewers paths.

inputs.name: credentialRecipeDigest.path
inputs.description: Recipe file path.

inputs.name: verifyCredentialRecipe.files
inputs.description: Recipe, review envelope and trusted reviewers file paths.

inputs.name: verifyCredentialRecipe.now
inputs.description: Review check time in Unix milliseconds; defaults to Date.now().

inputs.name: runCredentialRequest.options
inputs.description: Recipe files, action, optional account alias, tracker item, session, project, environment, host, runner key, reason, ready method kinds and socket.

inputs.name: serveCredentialBroker.options
inputs.description: Socket, state directory, trust file and approval origin, with optional protected browser delivery and lease teardown callbacks.

outputs.name: CredentialCommand.register
outputs.description: Adds credential serve, request, status, cancel, attach, finish and recipe; each prints JSON.

outputs.name: CredentialRecipeCommand.register
outputs.description: Adds credential recipe digest and recipe verify.

outputs.name: CredentialRecipeCommand.files
outputs.description: Absolute recipe, review and reviewers paths.

outputs.name: credentialRecipeDigest
outputs.description: Recipe digest and the display form Harness iOS shows.

outputs.name: verifyCredentialRecipe
outputs.description: The normalized recipe with its digest and display.

outputs.name: runCredentialRequest
outputs.description: requested with method, display and the broker ticket, or blocked or unsupported with a reason that never reached the phone.

outputs.name: serveCredentialBroker
outputs.description: The listening socket and a close() that stops the lease sweep and the server.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: 'Set HARNESS_VAULT_RECEIPT to the request receipt.' when status or cancel runs without it.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: Any broker client refusal: 503 unreachable, 504 timed out, or the broker status and message.

errors.name: NodeJS.ErrnoException
errors.description: The recipe file cannot be read.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: The recipe file is not JSON.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: The recipe does not match the recipe schema.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown by vaultRecipe when the recipe or review is invalid, for another digest, stale, or not signed by a trusted reviewer.

errors.name: NodeJS.ErrnoException
errors.description: A recipe, review or reviewers file cannot be read.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: A recipe, review or reviewers file is not JSON.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Any verifyCredentialRecipe refusal.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 400 'Unknown recipe action.'

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: Any broker refusal of the request, such as 429 queue full or 409 reused runner key, or 503/504 when unreachable.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: 'Invalid device key.' when an enrolled signing key is not a 65-byte uncompressed P-256 point.

errors.name: NodeJS.ErrnoException
errors.description: The trust file, state directory or socket cannot be read, created or listened on.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: The trust file is not JSON.
